END AS MES11, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(LAN.REFERENCIA,'MM') = 12 THEN LAN.VLRLANC * CASE WHEN LAN.TIPLANC = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END ELSE 0 END AS MES12, (LAN.VLRLANC * CASE WHEN LAN.TIPLANC = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE
